integrity: All proofs and finite symbolic checks are disclosed. Historical novelty remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the four-dimensional averaged slow flow only; the 2 gamma cubed transverse strip is sufficient, not claimed optimal. title: A sharp all-detuning global-attraction boundary and cubic critical slowing in Miles’ whirling-string flow
